description: Address 5 v2 review issues: marp-render/polly-worker event shape alignment, remove Map states for audio/clips, XML-escape plain text before Polly, and fix presigned URL ContentLength.
steps: Fix #1: Update marp-render handler to accept s3Bucket/s3Prefix instead of bucket/manifestKey
Fix #2: Update polly-worker handler to accept s3Bucket/s3Prefix instead of bucket/manifestKey
Fix #3: Remove Map states from state machine - make audio and clips single Task invocations (workers already process all pages)
Fix #4: XML-escape plain text in buildSpeakTag before wrapping in <speak> tags
Fix #5: Remove ContentLength from PutObjectCommand and content-length from signableHeaders in presigned URL generation
acceptance_criteria: marp-render accepts { s3Bucket, s3Prefix } and derives manifestKey internally
polly-worker accepts { s3Bucket, s3Prefix } and derives manifestKey internally
State machine has no Map states - audio and clips are single Task invocations
buildSpeakTag XML-escapes &, <, >, and " in plain mode text before lexicon application
Presigned URL does not include ContentLength or content-length in signableHeaders
marp-render returns { pages: [...] } array for downstream compatibility
